buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address BASE VICTUALLING YARD NAVAL BASE KOCHI 682004 . 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 2 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with Defence/Central Govt/NSIC for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid

opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.) 5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 6. Generic Staggered Delivery: The ordered items shall be supplied in a staggered manner. ( 730 Quantity shall be supplied within 15 days of contract placement and thereafter 730 Quantity per Fortnight) 7. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 12 MONTHS Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 09 MONTHS usable shelf life should be available / balance. 8. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 9. Inspection Testing of Sample: The testing of advance sample and bulk sample during PDI will be carried at the designated AHSP labs.When testing facilities are not available, the facilities of Govt labs/NABL/Accredited labs will be utilized. The testing charges outside the designated AHSP labs to be borne by seller's. 10. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 11. Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Short closure of ARC In case of full contract quantity utilized before completion of contract period or due to poor/short supply view unjustified reason, CFA ret ains the right of short closure during tendering/ contract period for any item mentioned without notice. Extension of contract In case of non-conclusion of new contract due to some special reason, the contract operating authority can initiate extension of the exis ting contract for a period generally not be more than three months with same terms and conditions etc, with the consent of the rate contract holder. Existing c ontractors which do not agree to such extensions, can be left out for consideration for renewal of the contract. Willingness of the firm is not be mandatory for i nvoking option clause and for invoking any other terms and conditions of contract. Risk & Expense Purchase Clause Risk and expense purchase is undertaken by the purchaser in the event of the supplier failing to honour the contracted obl igations within the stipulated period and where extension of delivery period is not approved. While initiating risk and expense at the cost and expense of the su pplier, the purchaser must satisfy himself that the supplier has failed to deliver and has been given adequate and proper notice to discharge his obligations. W henever risk purchase is resorted to, the supplier is liable to pay the additional amount spent by the government if any, in procuring the said contracted goods/ services through a fresh contract ie. the defaulting supplier has to bear the excess cost incurred as compared with the amount contracted with him. Factors lik e method of recovering such amount should also be considered while taking a decision to invoke the provision for risk purchase. Signing of contract agreement (Acceptance of Tender) The successful bidder/ contractor will be required to sign an agreement with the contract operatin g authority within 30 days from the date of award of contract. Provisioning of e-stamp paper and other requisite action as required are to be done by the contra ctor at his/her own expense. Format of AOT will be given by this office on award of contract that will have to be re-submitted within 30 days with the proprietor's signature and firm’s round stamp to this office which will act as agreement within 30 days of the payment will be stopped. Risk and expense may be done using PBG/ payments of other r unning contracts with Indian Navy. If the firm fails to submit contract agreement and PBG within 30 days of award on even after reminder letters issued by this office, CFA holds all the rights to terminate the contract without any prior notice and justification. Supply of the Items The items are to be supplied to BVY (Koc) as per demand in staggered delivery as per purchase orders raised by the BVO (Koc). Moreove r, all operational requirements of the Command are to be met by the vendor within 15 days as per the purchase order raised by the concerned units. Lab test Vendor has to bear lab test charges for random sampling carried out during supply period. Lab test of the tender sample will be carried out by the b uyer and the payment to be made by the bidder. An undertaking to pay the lab testing charges within 07 days of intimation to be submitted All rates to be quoted in Kgs/Liters and denomination for packing of items should be as mentioned at items name and declaration of the same should be furnis hed on bidder’s letter head. Option Clause The Contract will have an Option Clause, wherein the Buyer can exercise an option to procure an additional 50% of the original contracted quan tity in accordance with the same contract & conditions of the present contract. This will be applicable within the currency of the contract. It will be entirely the discretion of the buyer to exercise this option or not. Staggered Delivery of Item Delivery will be undertaken in staggered manner as per supply order. The delivery period, by which the items are required by th e buyer, will be mentioned in each supply order raised on the seller, based on the contract period of 730 days.

Performance Bank Guarantee Performance Security Deposit payable to the purchaser is furnished by the supplier in the form of Performance Bank Guarante e (PBG) issued by a Public sector bank or a Private scheduled commercial bank in the prescribed format within 30 days from the date of contract. The Performan ce Security Deposit is meant to compensate the contract. Preferably, performance security is payable by the supplier at the rate of 5% of the contract value. PB G should remain valid for a period of 60 days beyond the date of completion of contractual obligations including warrant. PBG returned to the supplier on successful completion of all his obligations under the contract. In case the execution of the contract is delayed beyond the contracted period and the purchaser grants extension of delivery period, with or without LD, the supplier must get the PBG re-validated, if not already valid. All terms and conditions of GeM bid and additional documents uploaded in quality assurance document be clearly read before quoting. Ink signed copy of duly f illed additional documents and GeM bid to be uploaded with technical documents. Any violation in terms and condition of additional documents and GeM bid d ocuments by firm would results in disqualification of firm at technical stage. If the L-1 firm withdraw its offer during tendering stage may be awarded tender holiday for a period of two (02) years. Firm’s who emerged as L-1 and subseque ntly withdrawn its offer post award of contract, it may be liable for penal action including imposition of tender holiday/blacklisting for a period of two years. Such firms will not eligible for participating the future tendering. An undertaking to pay the lab tes ting charges within 07 days of intimation to be submitted All rates to be q uoted in Kgs/Liters and denomination for packing of items should be as mentioned at items name and declaration of the same should be furnish ed on bidder’s letter head. Staggered Delivery of Item: Delivery will be undertaken in staggered manner as per supply order.
